meta.title: World Cup 2026 Match Center
meta.description: Every match, group, venue and bracket of the FIFA World Cup 2026 across USA, Canada and Mexico — with predictions, calendar export and an interactive map.

home.heroSubtitle: All 104 matches, 12 groups and 16 stadiums in one smart hub. Follow the bracket, predict results and never miss a kickoff.

rounds.title: Rounds & Bracket
rounds.subtitle: Follow how every result moves teams through the tournament — winners advance along the lines.
rounds.previewNote: Showing your predicted bracket. Official results override predictions as they arrive.

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: 12 groups, 48 teams. The top two of each group and the 8 best third-placed teams reach the Round of 32.
groups.qualifiedHint: Top 2 qualify · best 8 thirds also advance

matches.title: All matches
matches.subtitle: The complete 104-match schedule. Filter by date, group, team, venue or round.
matches.noResults: No matches found for these filters.

map.title: Stadium map
map.subtitle: 16 stadiums across three countries. Tap a marker for its matches, or trace a team's journey.

calendar.title: Match calendar
calendar.subtitle: Plan your World Cup. Export any selection straight to your own calendar.
calendar.noFavorites: Pick favorite teams in your hub first.
calendar.noSaved: You haven't saved any matches yet.
calendar.icsHint: The .ics file opens in Apple, Google, and Outlook calendars. Times convert to your timezone automatically.

auth.name: Name
auth.magicLinkSent: Check your inbox — your sign-in link is on its way.
auth.verifySent: Almost there! Confirm your email to activate your account.
auth.demoNote: No database is connected, so your profile lives in this browser only. Connect Supabase (see README) for real accounts and sync.
auth.redirectNotice: After authentication you will continue to {path}.

errors.unconfirmed: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Open the confirmation link we sent you, then sign in.
errors.config: Supabase is not configured for authentication.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.title: My Hub
dashboard.favoritesHint: Tap a flag to follow a team. Favorites power calendar export and reminders.
dashboard.noPredictions: No predictions yet — open any upcoming match to add one.
dashboard.editHint: You can edit a prediction until kickoff.
dashboard.signInPrompt: Sign in to keep predictions, favorites and saved matches.

admin.title: Admin · Results
admin.subtitle: Enter official results. Standings, qualification and the bracket recalculate instantly.
admin.denied: This area is for tournament admins only.
admin.deniedDemo: Local mode: results you enter here are stored in this browser and drive the whole app — perfect for testing.
admin.importHint: Bulk import or update the schedule with scripts/import-schedule.mjs (JSON/CSV → Supabase).

prediction.title: Your prediction
prediction.locked: Predictions closed — match has kicked off.
prediction.signIn: Sign in to save predictions across devices.
prediction.pickWinner: If it's a draw, who advances?

pwa.installHint: Add the Match Center to your home screen for instant, offline-ready access.
pwa.offline: You're offline — showing the saved schedule.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.subtitle: This page isn't saved for offline use yet. Pages you've already visited stay available without a connection.

footer.tagline: Mondial 2026 — FIFA World Cup Match Center
footer.about: Track every match, predict results, follow your favourite teams and venues across the USA, Canada & Mexico.
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with FIFA. Schedule data compiled from official sources; always verify kickoff times before traveling.

promo.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
promo.subtitle: Sign in and write your predictions — enjoy the Mundial!
